description: Discover names and shapes. With no name: lists every name with its kind (data = object shape: ticket, customer, server; query = tickets, customers, assets, timers, system, settings, events, users, api_keys, trace, errors or counters, the only names run_query accepts; tool = that tool's arguments). With a name from that list: the shape of that one. This does not perform the task. kind=query: the filterable keys are for run_query. kind=tool: these are the arguments, call that tool next and do not pass the tool name to run_query. kind=data: an object shape, call the tool named in next. An unknown name is an error. There is no list_schemas tool and no query_tickets tool.

name.description: Optional. Omit to list every name with its kind. Otherwise an exact name from that list. tickets, customers, assets, timers, system, settings, events, users, api_keys, trace, errors or counters are for run_query. A tool name such as run_query only returns arguments, then call the tool. ticket, customer and server are shapes, not queries.

name: get_schema
